rules.text: One live knowledge base belongs to an agent. Its attached numbers use that base on enabled channels. Only the active revision and eligible, unsuppressed pieces enter live retrieval.
rules.why: The live query matches account, agent, revision and channel. Its selection has no per-number knowledge policy.

rules.text: A small eligible base is supplied whole. Larger bases use question matches. Seeing all small-base pieces does not mean that they answer a particular question. Use the configured not-found response for missing information.
rules.why: The live and Test paths share a selection decision. Evidence and an answer are different things.

rules.text: Knowledge and its enabled channels belong to the agent. Retired per-number knowledge operations return 410 number_knowledge_removed.
rules.instead: Use separate agents when a number needs different knowledge or none.

rules.text: Knowledge Test accepts knowledge mode. It does not simulate the number’s whole call prompt or take a call purpose.
rules.instead: Use Knowledge Test for source-backed answers. Use an actual test call to check the complete call instructions.

rules.text: Prepare knowledge from text, a supported file or selected website pages. Review drafts, edit topics and publish approved material.
Use pasted text, PDF, DOCX or plain UTF-8 text, or discover a website and import selected pages. API submissions can request review.
Choose the enabled channels. The initial default is inbound only.
Choose the match setting from the supported options below. The default is Strict. Set not_found to nonblank wording within the indicated character limit.
Maximum sources, original-text tokens and topics per base are shown below.
File size in bytes, source tokens and PDF pages are capped per source.
The limit is [[kb-count]] nondeleted knowledge bases per account. Agent count is independent.

Reads use the authenticated account. With organisation roles enabled, ordinary reads allow Owner, Admin and Member. Editing knowledge requires write permission. Reusing a write key with different information is refused.
rules.why: The route supplies identity and authorises the operation. The store binds a previous write to its content.

rules.text: Read or create/update the target agent’s base. Supply expected_revision for edits and an Idempotency-Key for writes.
Submit sources, inspect and accept a draft, or manage individual topics. Use the current revision for guarded writes.
Start an agent test session, then post messages to that session. Start with an active base that has an approved usable topic.
Read the account’s knowledge capabilities, limits and defaults.
Read the agent’s automatic keyterms and manual terms with their separate counts and limits.
410 number_knowledge_removed means a retired number-knowledge operation was requested. Resolve the attached agent instead.
409 stale_revision means the base changed. Read its current revision before reapplying the intended edit.
409 knowledge_missing means Test needs a ready base with an active usable topic. Add and approve one before testing.
413 source_limit means the source exceeds the text input limit. Split it into complete smaller documents.
Knowledge Test limits session starts per account per day, input characters per message and retained history entries.
Default token budget for a small whole-base pack. Deployments may adjust it. Use capabilities and Knowledge Test when evaluating a real base.
